question: Surupa Sen is a famous _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Surupa Sen,** an accomplished** Odissi dancer **and choreographer, has dedicated her career to the art form while residing and working in Nrityagram, a renowned dance village located in **rural Karnataka, India.**
 
• Her journey in Odissi commenced two decades ago under the** tutelage of Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra, the eminent architect of Odissi.**
 
• Surupa honed her skills under the guidance of Guru Protima Gauri, Guru Ratikant Mahapatra, and Guru Bichitranandan Swain. Throughout her illustrious career, Surupa has been recognized with several prestigious awards.
 
• These include the Raza Foundation Award in 2006, the Yagnaraman Award from Sri Krishna Gana Sabha, Chennai in 2008, the Nritya Choodamani from Sri Krishna Gana Sabha, Chennai in 2011, and the esteemed Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Odissi Dance in 2018. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Odissi**, a classical Indian dance, finds its roots in the ancient temples of Odisha, a coastal state in eastern India.
 
• **Kathak**, one of the eight principal forms of Indian classical dance, traces its origins to the wandering bards of ancient northern India, known as Kathakar or storytellers.
 
• **Kathakali **is a classical Indian dance-drama that emerged from the state of Kerala in southwestern India.
 
• **Bharatanatyam, **another classical Indian dance form, originated in the state of Tamil Nadu, India.
